title: "Light don go": when Nigeria''s power cuts out, my laptop sends me outside
why_read: A whimsical personal hackathon project that nudges the author to stretch during power outages, with little broader technical substance beyond a simple battery-status trigger and UI.
analysis: This is a Hacktoberfest challenge submission describing a small app that detects when a laptop switches to battery power during Nigerian electricity outages and displays a full-screen stretch-break reminder. The technical implementation seems to be a simple battery-status listener paired with a themed UI and a local AI model (Gemma) generating a motivational line. It's a charming personal story about local infrastructure problems, but there is minimal reusable technical insight for other engineers.
